messages:
maria: Created RC in CI: rc-bridge-v1 (artifact: ef56be9). Includes embedding batching change and opt-in darklaunch for bridge routing. Planning prod window 09:00-11:00 UTC. Need DB migration gating and ops + QA signoff. @james-oncall @rhea
tom: changelog looked good. migration is additive (new column, backfilled async). staging migration ran fine. recommend canary at 3% with feature-flagged traffic.
rhea: QA passed core flows on staging. noticed slight increase in DB write tail latencies during backfill but within budget. :eyes:
deploy-bot: Release candidate recorded: rc-bridge-v1 (sha: ef56be9). Promotion command: `/deploy promote rc-bridge-v1 --to=prod --canary=3% --ff=bridge-dark`
maria: pinning artifact to release registry: `releasectl pin rc-bridge-v1 --reason="originate: db-gated deploy"`
oliver: Ops checklist: pre-run migration via job, set feature flag to dark, prefix-kv warm for embedding keys, enable trace sampling for 5% on canary. I'll trigger migration and post status.
james-oncall: I'm oncall for window. Abort triggers: DB migration errors > 0, DB queue depth > 1000, or error-rate > 0.7% for 4m. I'll watch metrics and be ready to flip flag or rollback.
oliver: kicking off migration job: ```bash
kubectl apply -f k8s/migrations/2024_add_bridge_column-job.yaml
# monitor: kubectl logs job/2024-add-bridge-column -f
```
deploy-bot: Migration job started. Logs streaming to ops channel. Backfill progress: 0% -> 18% -> 52% (updates in thread).
oliver: backfill at ~52%, write latencies bumped but under 30ms SLA. continuing.
rhea: running targeted E2E against canary once migration hits >=50%. will validate bridge routing and embeddings.
deploy-bot: Migration job completed with exit code 0. Backfill duration ~6m.
maria: migration successful. ready for canary promotion with FF dark. Tom and Rhea please confirm final thumbs.
tom: thumbs. proceed to 3% canary.
rhea: confirmed. running canary smoke now.
deploy-bot: Initiating canary rollout (3%). Routing updated, 2 canary pods created, FF=bridge-dark set for canary. KV pre-warm started.
deploy-bot: Canary pods healthy. KV prefix cache warmed to ~88% hit. Starting 12m observation window.
james-oncall: initial metrics: error-rate +0.1%, p95 +60ms. DB queue depth nominal. watching for backfill rechecks.
rhea: smoke E2E against canary: OK for chat, embeddings match baseline. minor percent diff in sequence lengths but not concerning.
maria: hold for 12m observation then manual ops approval to ramp. also planning small release note snippet for internal changelog.
tom: if anything shows DB queue creep, we flip feature flag off rather than full rollback. prefer feature-flag-based degrade path.
deploy-bot: 12m observation window complete — no abort triggers. Awaiting manual approval from james-oncall to continue ramp.
james-oncall: I approve ramp to 30%. keeping trace sampling on for canary window.
deploy-bot: Ramping to 30% with auto-hold for 10m.
oliver: watching DB metrics and tail latencies. nothing alarming.
rhea: QA running regression suite at 30%, clear so far.
deploy-bot: Auto-hold complete. No abort. Ready to promote to 100% on manual go.
maria: final check from ops? If green, I'll run promote to 100% and unflag darklaunch to open routing.
james-oncall: green. Proceed but leave short-term trace sampling and alerts for 30m.
maria: executing final promote: `/deploy promote rc-bridge-v1 --to=prod --canary=100% --ff=bridge-dark=false`
deploy-bot: Promotion to 100% started. Draining canaries and updating routing.
deploy-bot: Promotion completed at 2024-05-02T09:47:12Z. All instances reporting healthy. Feature flag unrolled.
james-oncall: post-promote check: DB queues normal, error-rate steady. No rollback needed. Great job.
tom: I'll paste release note to #release-notes and mark internal changelog. small note about DB backfill and darklaunch toggle.
rhea: closing QA signoff.
maria: closing thread. artifacts pinned and audit log updated. Thanks team! :party_parrot:
